properties.description: Occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue model at every eligible pre/post observation. Acceptance uses expected pre-edge occupancy, including rejection of writes at full and reads at empty.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains sixteen words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words.

When the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals its oldest accepted word, including simultaneous transfers, pointer wraparound and operation after reset. Empty data is unspecified and not checked.
Following a synchronous reset edge, occupancy is zero, full is low and empty is high, including resets that discard queued data.
Public occupancy is in the range zero through sixteen, and public full and empty flags agree with that occupancy. Unknown occupancy or status values cause an alarm.
